# Security Policy

English · Türkçe: [docs/tr/SECURITY.md](../docs/tr/SECURITY.md)

If you find a security problem in Daeva Lens, please **do not open a public issue**. Use GitHub's private reporting: the **Security** tab > **Report a vulnerability**. Describe what you found and how to reproduce it. We will reply as soon as we can; this is a volunteer project, so there is no fixed deadline.

Only the latest release is supported. The app never connects to the outside. The local (127.0.0.1) connect option in the helper program is not used by the app. Daeva Lens does not read game memory; if you see behavior that contradicts this, please report it.
